architecture_spine.name: The Corridor Has a Spine
architecture_spine.description: A research model of eight procedural architectural bays. Lift the pink handle to move all hinges from floor to roof; dials bend the hierarchy, separate its connections, and compound a scale ratio. Same rigid parts, different assembly. Model only: moving structure has no collision, gravity, portals or navigation. Use its separate preview.tscn review room.
interactions: Lift the pink handle to move the shared hinge height from floor to roof.
BEND changes each joint angle; SEPARATE deliberately disconnects them.
EACH BAY compounds uniform scale through the hierarchy.
PASSAGE, FOLD and SLIP compare presets; RESET restores the original assembly.
architecture_spine.qfep_connection: A valid transform can retain every architectural part while destroying the route between them. Chosen centres determine which boundary stays connected; attachment alone does not establish an inhabitable space.
architecture_spine.status: research prototype; standalone controls tested, physical headset and walkable conversion pending
